hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Read the division as a counting question: how many groups of three tenths fit into fifteen tenths?
A division keeps the same answer when both numbers are multiplied by the same amount. What could you multiply by to make the divisor a whole number?
Multiply both $1.5$ and $0.3$ by $10$. The problem becomes $15 \div 3$, which has the same quotient.
$15 \div 3 = 5$, so the answer to $1.5 \div 0.3$ is also $5$.

explanation: Dividing by a decimal is easier after the divisor is turned into a whole number.
Multiply both numbers by $10$. This does not change the quotient, and it turns $1.5 \div 0.3$ into $15 \div 3$.
Now divide the whole numbers in the usual way: $15 \div 3 = 5$.
So $1.5 \div 0.3 = 5$. You can check by multiplying back: $0.3 \times 5 = 1.5$.
